blocking_issues.finding: validate_forecast_feature_values claims to validate/copy recursive JSON-safe feature values but accepts arbitrary nested collections.abc.Mapping objects and performs only a shallow top-level copy. A nested MappingProxyType passes validation, remains a mappingproxy in the returned value, and immediately fails json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False) with TypeError. ForecastFeatureSlot.values is therefore not guaranteed JSON-serializable by the runtime validator.
evidence: agents/state.py validates every Mapping recursively but does not restrict nested objects to dict or normalize them recursively.
agents/state.py returns dict(values), which converts only the root mapping.
Independent counterexample returned nested type mappingproxy and json.dumps raised: Object of type mappingproxy is not JSON serializable.
blocking_issues.required_change: Either reject non-dict nested Mapping values or recursively materialize every accepted Mapping/list subtree into plain JSON-native dict/list/scalars, then add a regression proving every accepted return value succeeds under json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False) and that mappingproxy/custom Mapping behavior is explicitly covered.
